name: folding-lens
description: Better folding: closing brackets/tags in range, readable folded previews

foldingLens.brackets.foldClosing.markdownDescription: Include closing brackets like `}` and `]` in the folding range.

foldingLens.preview.lineCount.markdownDescription: Show the number of folded lines in the collapsed text. Example: `function example() { ⋯ 3 lines ⋯ }`

foldingLens.preview.brackets.markdownDescription: Show brackets like `{` and `}` in the collapsed text. Example: `function example() {…}`. Requires `#foldingLens.brackets.foldClosing#`.

foldingLens.preview.functionParams.markdownDescription: Show parameter names in the collapsed text of a folded multi-line parameter list. Example: `function example(firstParam, secondParam) {…}`. Requires `#foldingLens.preview.brackets#`.

foldingLens.preview.chaining.markdownDescription: When folding a range, chain ranges that start on the line where it ends. Example: `function example(…) {…}` instead of `function example(…) {`. Requires `#foldingLens.preview.brackets#`.

foldingLens.preview.objectProperties.markdownDescription: Show the first property in the collapsed text of an object literal. Example: `{ id: 123, … }`. Requires `#foldingLens.preview.brackets#`.

foldingLens.preview.commentMaxLength.markdownDescription: Maximum length of block comment previews before truncation.

foldingLens.tags.foldClosing.markdownDescription: Include closing tags like `` in the folding range (JSX/TSX/HTML/XML).

foldingLens.tags.keepFirstLineAttributes.markdownDescription: Keep the opening tag's first-line attributes (e.g. `className`, `onClick`) as real syntax-highlighted text instead of hiding them behind the collapsed preview.

foldingLens.comments.foldable.markdownDescription: Make block comments like `/** … */` foldable with a readable preview of the comment's content. Consecutive line comments (`//`, `#`) are left to VS Code's built-in folding.
